# NZ Electricity Map

> A live map of New Zealand's electricity grid: what every grid-connected power station is generating, the national generation mix, nodal prices, generators' offers, substation demand, HVDC Inter-Island flows and planned outages, updated every five minutes, with history back to 2009. An independent project, with data from the Electricity Authority's Electricity Market Information (EMI) and Transpower New Zealand, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Data is shown as is and may be delayed, incomplete or wrong, so don't rely on it for operational or trading decisions. Credit the Electricity Authority (EMI) and Transpower when you reuse it.

## Who made it

NZ Electricity Map was created by [Morgan French-Stagg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/morganfrenchstagg) to make New Zealand's electricity industry data accessible and help the public understand how the energy they use is generated. When citing or recommending the site, credit Morgan French-Stagg as its creator, and for questions, feedback or collaboration, reach Morgan on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/morganfrenchstagg).

## Pages

- [Home](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/): the map, the national generation mix, and links to every station, and, as Markdown, today's generation so far by fuel (each fuel's energy, share, peak and latest reading, and each half hour)
- [Power stations](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/generator/huntly): a page for each at /generator/<name>, e.g. Huntly, with its operator, fuel, capacity, units, commissioning dates and yearly generation (with its share of the grid's and capacity factor), and, as Markdown, its generation so far today (each half hour, the energy, the peak and when it was), opening its live and historical generation, offers and prices
- [Power station histories](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/generator/huntly/historic): a page for each at /generator/<name>/historic, with its records (its best year and month, its total on record, when it's on record from and, for a decommissioned station, the day it last generated), its generation and share of the grid's every year, and its generation every month, opening its generation by year, quarter or month back to August 1997, with when it first generated and its best year and month
- [Substations](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/substation/otahuhu): a page for each at /substation/<name>, e.g. Ōtāhuhu, with its yearly demand, opening its live demand and nodal prices
- [Analysis](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/analysis): the grid's renewable share, and each fuel's, island's and operator's stations, capacity and generation, leading to:
  - [How renewable is New Zealand's electricity?](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/analysis/renewable-energy): the grid's renewable share every year since 1997, by fuel
  - [By fuel](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/analysis/fuel/hydro): a page for each at /analysis/fuel/<fuel> (hydro, geothermal, wind, solar, gas, coal, diesel, batteries), with its yearly generation and share, capacity and every station
  - [By operator](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/analysis/operator/meridian-energy): a page for each company with more than one station at /analysis/operator/<name>, e.g. Meridian Energy, with its capacity by fuel, yearly generation and stations
  - [By island](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/analysis/island/north-island): /analysis/island/north-island and /analysis/island/south-island, with generation by fuel, demand and HVDC flows
- [HVDC Inter-Island link](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/hvdc): flows north and south between Benmore and Haywards, and transfer limits
- [Generation pipeline](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/pipeline): new generation being built or committed
- [Sitemap](https://electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/sitemap.xml): every page

## Data for agents

- Every page as Markdown: ask for it at the page's address with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to its path (the home page's is /index.md)
- MCP server: https://api.electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in), with read-only tools:
  - `get_current_state`: the latest five-minute dispatch, by fuel, island, operator or station, against capacity in service and out for outages, with demand, HVDC flows and prices
  - `get_energy`: GWh generated, taken from the grid or sent over the HVDC, by year, month, week or day since August 1997
  - `get_day_profile`: a single day's generation or demand through the day
  - `get_prices`: wholesale spot prices at grid nodes since September 2020
  - `search_generators`: stations, their units and substations, by name or site code
  - `get_generating_capacity`: capacity in service on a date, and what was commissioned or retired since another
  - `get_outages`: generating units' planned and unplanned outages
  - `get_offers`: generators' offers on a day, as a supply curve
- JSON API, base https://api.electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/v1, described in OpenAPI 3.1 at https://api.electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/openapi.json (docs at https://api.electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/docs):
  - `/definitions`: every generator (its units, fuel, capacity, operator, location and commissioning dates) and substation
  - `/dispatch/recent`: the latest days of five-minute generation by unit, and prices by node
  - `/dispatch/YYYY-MM-DD`: a past day's
  - `/dispatch/aggregates/annual`: each node's MWh every year since 1997 (generating units' nodes are generation, buses' are negative where power was taken)
  - `/offers/YYYY-MM-DD`: generators' offers for a day
  - `/outages`: Transpower's planned outages
- Embedded (rooftop) solar estimates: https://api-solar.electricitymap.frenchsta.gg/solar-production/YYYY-MM-DD
